demos.welcomeMessage: Leave us a toast — a memory, a wish, or a terrible joke. No account needed.

messages.text: May your arguments be short, your Sunday mornings long, and your house always smell like someone just baked something.
Still can’t believe you two met over the last samosa. Please never stop telling that story.
I was asked to be profound. Instead: don’t forget to eat cake. Also I love you both.
Look after each other. That’s the whole job.
The guestbook is already prettier than our Slack channel. Congratulations, you two.

messages.guestName: A guest who forgot their name tag
messages.text: Left a toast without making an account, which feels like the most 2026 thing we could have done for you.

demos.welcomeMessage: Leave Lena a wish — a memory, a joke, or a photo from the party. No account needed.

messages.text: Thirty never looked so good. May this year be loud, kind, and full of cake for breakfast.
You once said you’d never throw a party. Look at this guestbook. Happy birthday, you wonderful hypocrite.
Another trip around the sun. Keep collecting people who make you laugh like this.
Please keep celebrating this loudly. Also, we left sparkling wine by the door.
Still the person I’d call to pick me up from the airport. Wishing you a year as generous as you are.

messages.guestName: A guest who slipped in late
messages.text: Didn’t catch the speeches. Caught the joy. Happy birthday, Lena.

demos.welcomeMessage: Leave Jordan a wish — advice, a memory, or congratulations. No account needed.

messages.text: You asked better questions than you answered, which is how this is supposed to work. Go make something that lasts.
Four years of instant noodles and panic. You did the hard part. Now go nap, then change the world a little.
Proud is too small a word. Take the afternoon off from proving anything.
You still have to come to my recitals even though you’re a graduate now. That’s the deal.
Talent is common. Showing up is not. You showed up.
Congrats. The rest of us are still looking for our tassels.

demos.welcomeMessage: Leave Noah a note — a blessing, a memory, or congratulations. No account needed.

messages.text: Mazel tov, Noah. May this day be the first of many where your voice carries.
Today you stood up and read. Tomorrow you get to keep standing up for people. We’re so proud.
A beautiful milestone, celebrated in your own way. May the years ahead be full of curiosity and kindness.
You nailed it. Also you still have to pass the challah. Mazel tov.
We knew you’d get here. Save us a seat at the party.

messages.guestName: A guest from the next table
messages.text: Didn’t know the family well. Left knowing the joy. Mazel tov, Noah.
